Rae (PM): Need one final playbook for the design-partner sprint. Short, measurable, and hard gates. Can we land a version today so outreach can go tomorrow?

Owen (Revenue): We should call it a 6-week "handshake" pilot — easier to sell than "private preview". Incentives: $3k credit + case-study slot. Ask for a named sponsor and tech lead.

Mei (Research): Key ask: capture reproducible prompts + a single primary success metric per partner (latency, accuracy, cost). We'll require a 2-min screen clip of the current flow to prioritize.

Carlos (Infra): Capacity note: we can host 5 full private stacks concurrently. Recommend cohort size 5 starters max + 1 early sandbox. Require a baseline eval gate so we don't overpromise.

Dee (Solutions): Recruiting tip: add a single checkbox for KMS/S3 export need. If checked, we surface legal early. Cuts downstream delays.

Rae (PM): Draft gating checklist (must complete before kickoff): 1) Form + 2-min video, 2) baseline eval run, 3) choose telemetry profile, 4) named contacts, 5) SLA acknowledgement.

Owen (Revenue): Outreach snippet (short): "Limited handshake pilot: dedicated onboarding, tuning, and $3k credit. Quick 5-min form + 2-min video. Interested?"

Mei (Research): Feedback cadence: weeks 0-1: twice-weekly 30m working sessions; weeks 2-6: weekly 60m + office hours. Weekly quick-form (5 Qs) for ease/quality/blocks.

Carlos (Infra): Baseline eval CLI (gating): `redwood-eval --suite handshake-gate --routes routes.json --out gate.json`. Gate pass = p95 within 3x our target baseline or willingness to use sandbox.

Dee (Solutions): Telemetry profiles: Minimal (aggregates), Sampled (aggregates + sampled outputs opt-in), Custodian (customer S3/KMS). Add consent checkbox and retention default 30d.

Rae (PM): Success criteria (cohort): 4 orgs active within 10 days, median p95 meets SLO for 80% of routes across active orgs, >=3 reproducible feature asks with examples, cohort satisfaction >=6/10 at week 4.

Owen (Revenue): Risk mitigations: scope creep -> out-of-scope doc + paid consulting; onboarding no-shows -> require named tech lead and 48h pre-kickcheck; privacy issues -> telemetry opt-out + AD if retention >30d.

Mei (Research): Deliverable from us each week: signal pack (perf snapshot, prompt regressions, top asks). We'll tag asks in JIRA with partner id.

Carlos (Infra): Escalation: SE triage within 24h, infra fix/rollback 48h, security/legal escalation immediate pause + notify. Include contact matrix in onboarding doc.

Rae (PM): Action items: Owen: outreach copy + cohort sheet by EOD; Carlos: gate CLI + sandbox plan by tomorrow; Dee: telemetry consent text + SLA blurb by tomorrow; Mei: signal pack template by EOD. I'll finalize playbook and post invites when we have the form.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2367890160 (ping #product)

Owen (Revenue): I'll post the draft outreach in this thread shortly.

Rae (PM): Thanks team — keep the form lean. Customers ditch long forms. :thumbsup:
